provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C26 negative cases; injected failures and access violations, no real credentials.

cases.description: Sensitive reveal operation without step-up authentication challenge must return STEP_UP_REQUIRED
Revoked member access must fail immediately on the next request without waiting for cache/session expiry
Cross-tenant or out-of-scope identity must be rejected with UNAUTHORIZED
Expired session identity must be refused with UNAUTHORIZED
When provider is unreachable or returns 503, operations must fail closed with explicit typed error
Creating a grant with missing or invalid parameters must return INVALID_INPUT
Request with forged or mismatched role headers must be refused
Synthetic secret canary values must never appear in metadata, logs, disk files, or headers
